newsitem.title: USA: Rivlin - strong dollar helps on inflation front.
newsitem.headline: Rivlin - strong dollar helps on inflation front.

text.p: Federal Reserve Board Vice Chairwoman Alice Rivlin said Friday that the strong dollar has pluses and minuses and on the positive side it helps keep inflation under control.

"Clearly there are pluses and minuses; the strength of the dollar is helping us very much on inflation at the moment, but export industries for good reasons worry about it," Rivlin said in a question and answer session with reporters following a speech to an Emerging Issues Forum at North Carolina State University in Raleigh, N.C..
She was also asked about the two vacancies on the seven-member Fed board and said she hoped they would be filled soon.
"I hope the president will get on with his nominations as quickly as possible and I think that likely," she said.
The White House said Friday that President Clinton received a list Thursday night of possible choices for the vacancies but doubted whether he would make a decision this week.
